merges.resolution_basis: Control Center-authorized Loyola Chicago Stage 1 maintenance. Current protected main contains duplicate physical identities for the University of Illinois Assembly Hall / State Farm Center building in Champaign, Illinois. Preserve established VEN-000196 / state-farm-center, whose venue-name authority already carries the official Assembly Hall naming period (1963-03-02 through 2013-04-28), the State Farm Center naming period beginning 2013-04-29, and the Assembly Hall (Illinois) alias; retire later duplicate VEN-000967 / assembly-hall-illinois introduced during Long Island University onboarding. Preserve literal source assertions and historical naming evidence. This is a shared physical-venue identity repair, not Loyola Chicago historical re-research.
